app.name: Agentic Academy
app.footer: Learn to engineer reliable AI agents.

states.errorBody: We could not load this content. Your progress is safe.
states.offline: You are offline. Your work is kept on this device and will be sent when you reconnect.
states.notFound: We could not find this page.

auth.checkEmailBody: If the address can be used, we sent a link to {{email}}. The link expires in 24 hours.
auth.verified: Your email is verified. You can now sign in.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for this address, we sent a reset link. It expires in 1 hour.
auth.resetDone: Your password was changed and every session was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
auth.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, your progress and all your submissions. This cannot be undone.
auth.reauth: Your session expired. Sign in again; your unsent work is kept on this device.

errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.weak_password: Use a password of 12 to 128 characters.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.

catalog.title: Curriculum
catalog.intro: A progressive path from LLM foundations to production agents. Start with the foundations; later paths build on them.

path.objectives: What you will be able to do
path.entryPrereqsIntro: This path expects the following. Tick what you are comfortable with; this checklist is only for you and does not count as progress.
path.plannedNotice: This path is planned and cannot be started yet.
path.signInToStudy: Sign in to study this path and save your progress.

module.missingPrereqs: You have not demonstrated these prerequisites yet. You can continue, but you may want to review them first:
module.challengeLater: In progress — challenge available in a later release
module.labNote: Laboratory exploration is practice; it does not count as evidence of a competency.

check.question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
check.unansweredBody: {{count}} question(s) have no answer. Unanswered questions count as incorrect.
check.competencyPending: Objectives demonstrated. Complete the module's code challenge to demonstrate its competencies.

challenge.hintsIntro: Stuck? {{total}} hints are available, from general to specific. Using hints is recorded but never penalized.
challenge.unavailable: Code evaluation is unavailable right now. Your code is saved; try again in a few minutes.
challenge.inProgress: Wait for your current run to finish.
challenge.delayed: This is taking longer than usual; you can keep working.
challenge.infraError: Something went wrong on our side while evaluating. This does not count as an attempt; please submit again.
challenge.passedNote: All mandatory criteria are met. The challenge is completed.

stop.timeout: Stopped: your code ran longer than the time limit. Check for infinite loops.
stop.memory: Stopped: your code used too much memory.
stop.output_limit: Stopped: your code printed too much output.
stop.forbidden_operation: Stopped: a forbidden operation was attempted (network, processes or system files).

dashboard.title: My progress
dashboard.noPaths: No learning paths are available yet.
dashboard.welcomeBody: Progress here reflects what you demonstrate — passed knowledge checks and code challenges — not just what you read. Start with the foundations; later paths build on them.
dashboard.noPending: All objectives of this path are demonstrated.
dashboard.completedBody: These competencies are demonstrated, with the evidence that demonstrated them:
dashboard.resetWarning: This permanently deletes your lesson history, knowledge-check attempts, code and submissions for {{path}}. It cannot be undone.
